# Periodic representative volume element made of two layers (example ex6 of
# mfem-mgis-examples: Saint Venant-Kirchhoff hyperelasticity, imposed
# macroscopic deformation gradient), with its behaviour generated by the
# generic-parallel interface. The executable is the one of
# mfem-mgis-examples, run in its build directory, the behaviour library
# being given by its option -l; the mode of integration is given by the
# environment variables of mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_BINARY_DIR}/ex6"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex6 of mfem-mgis-examples")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex6-behaviours CUDA
  "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex6/SaintVenantKirchhoffElasticity.mfront")

# tests on two processes, the deformation gradient and the stress at each
# integration point being compared to the analytical solution of the
# example, point by point (generic library of the example), all the
# computations by kernels with the generic library and by batches with
# each backend
proto_check_executable(_usable "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR}/rve")
if(_usable)
  set(_run mpirun -n 2 ./rve --no-post-processing --verbosity-level 0)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  add_test(NAME ex6-point-by-point COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ex6-kernels COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ex6-point-by-point PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
  set_tests_properties(ex6-kernels PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
  foreach(_backend ${ex6-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      add_test(NAME ex6-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} --device cuda -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex6-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}"
        RESOURCE_LOCK gpu)
    else()
      add_test(NAME ex6-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX6_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex6-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=2;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
